# Introduction

This project is configured for:

- Quarto manuscript authoring with `.qmd` files.
- Jupyter notebooks included as project computations.
- Publishing from GitHub to Posit Connect Cloud.
- Reproducible notebook execution on MyBinder.

# Example Figure

The computational workflow is documented in the notebook set:

- [Data Preview](notebooks/01-data-preview.ipynb)
- [Summary Statistics](notebooks/02-summary-stats.ipynb)

These notebooks are discoverable from the manuscript website and can be
downloaded by readers.

# Data Stewardship

This starter project follows reproducibility-oriented practices aligned with FAIR
principles [@wilkinson2016fair].

# Reproducibility Notes

Package dependencies are pinned in `requirements.txt` and Python runtime is pinned in `runtime.txt`.
